reviews.text: The car looks NEW! I could not be happier with my experience with Cleant, from that first friendly interactions with Paris and his staff to the big REVEAL after they had worked their magic! I was most impressed with the final results… Paris's initial estimate was spot-on the bill I was presented, and every detail was meticulously perfeected before the care was returned. I will use Cleant again!
reviews.name: Laura Munn

reviews.text: Cleant is THE definition of detailing. They were able to fit me into their busy schedule. When my truck took longer than expected, they did not cut any corners, and finished the job. The owner, Paris, was very professional. I will definitely be back.
reviews.name: Justin Crabtree

reviews.text: Mr. Cleant and his crew are the only people I trust to work on my projects. They blacked out my E 63 AMG wagon and I have plans to get some more products for them such as paint correction and PPF I wouldn’t go anywhere else.
reviews.name: Julian Georgescu

reviews.text: Cannot say enough about this business!!! Wow, above and beyond, attention to detail, they walk you through anything you want to know, they don’t just tell you they show you. Super professional, friendly, helpful, everything.
reviews.name: Brady Brink

reviews.text: I’ve been taking my cars to Paris at Cleant Industries for years. They are the only shop in town I trust to detail and coat my cars. Whenever I get a car back from Paris the color just seems to pop in a way that it doesn’t when I attempt to clean it myself.
reviews.name: Brett J.
